parent_objective: implement bounded source-diverse history interventions over M1570 flip anchors
blocked_by: source-diverse flip-anchor history-intervention runner has not been implemented

public_gates: M1573 must implement the M1572 bounded history-intervention design
M1573 must run only public bounded history interventions over M1570 anchors
M1573 must report source-family and window summaries
M1573 must report high-speed and late-reveal families separately
M1573 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the first history-intervention smoke over the M1570 source-diverse flip-anchor active set
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public bounded history-intervention implementation only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop after one bounded implementation smoke and route to audit
stop if implementation changes actor inputs or writes training corpus
stop if implementation omits current-frame substitution controls
stop if late_reveal_boundary reporting is missing
fallback_plan: route to result audit whether gates pass or fail
if interventions are null, classify current-frame substitution, donor mismatch, or family-specific late-reveal null before adding generators
keep M1570/M1573 as public diagnostic evidence only until audited
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1572 admits one bounded source-diverse history-intervention implementation

admission_evidence: M1572 pre-registers target anchors, donor pairing, intervention variants, metrics, artifacts, and gates
allowed_updates: M1573 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: source-family and window summaries are written

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1573 explicitly tests current-frame substitution via zero-current, zero-action-history, zero-all, and donor response/action controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If history interventions are null, classify the null before any new generator, corpus export, or training.
allowed_claims: at most level2 history-encoded reactive evidence if wrong-history or donor-plus-hidden produces outcome degradation and controls do not dominate
no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded source-diverse intervention smoke can test whether M1570 flip-anchor behavior depends on history beyond current-frame controls.
success_criteria: focused tests cover donor pairing and summary gates
high-speed and late-reveal family metrics are reported
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: implementation changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
implementation exports a training corpus or starts training/PPO
decision_rule: M1573 passes as implementation if it runs bounded interventions with clean guardrails and writes the required metrics; it must still route to audit before materialization.
